name: agentlinkops
description: Five product skills for AgentLinkOps connection, backlink discovery, campaign preparation, local CRM records and focused linkable assets. Use the customer's own research and sender tools. Optional content and SEO are outside this pack; their separate artifacts await source, rights and dependency qualification.

interface.shortDescription: Run backlink campaigns with your own agent.
interface.longDescription: Plan campaigns and preserve contacts, outreach references and placements in a local SQLite CRM. Manage property-scoped disavow lists and generate branded HTML reports offline. Optional account-connected event sync preserves local notes and costs.
defaultPrompt: Plan a backlink campaign for my product.
Set up my local link and outreach CRM.
Review changes to my monitored placements.
